test_idle_session_expired: test _is_session_expired returns True for a session idle beyond the configured threshold
test_active_session_not_expired: test _is_session_expired returns False for a session updated within the idle window
test_none_mode_never_expires: test _is_session_expired returns False when reset policy mode is none
test_active_processes_prevent_expiry: test _is_session_expired returns False when active background processes are present
test_daily_mode_expired: test _is_session_expired detects expiry under daily reset policy for sessions older than reset hour
test_auto_reset_creates_new_session: test get_or_create_session creates a new session_id and sets was_auto_reset after a flushed session expires
test_no_sync_callback_invoked: test get_or_create_session does not invoke a synchronous callback during auto-reset
test_memory_flushed_flag_defaults_false: test SessionEntry memory_flushed defaults to False on creation
test_memory_flushed_persists_through_sav: test memory_flushed flag survives save/load cycle simulating a restart
test_legacy_entry_defaults_false: test SessionEntry.from_dict defaults memory_flushed to False for legacy entries missing the field
